description: Request a pairing code as a text-based alternative to scanning the QR code. The user enters the returned 8-character code on their phone under Settings > Linked Devices > Link a device > "Link with phone number instead".

phone_number.description: The WhatsApp phone number to link, in international symbol-free format (e.g. 4915112345678 for Germany, 12025550108 for US)

name: request_pairing_code
